# Katharine Wolanyk discusses the outlook for IP monetization in JUVE Patent


- Patent & IP


October 5, 2026


-
-
-
-


In an article for *JUVE Patent* , Burford Capital’s[Katharine Wolanyk](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/katharine-wolanyk/) explores the evolving landscape for IP monetization and what it means for corporate legal teams. She discusses key trends shaping patent monetization and considers how businesses can take a more strategic approach to unlocking the value of their IP assets.


[Read the full article here.](https://www.juve-patent.com/sponsored/burford-capital/ip-monetization-outlook-key-insights-for-legal-teams/)
